answer: Assign graders by lottery from the whole network each epoch, so no one knows in advance who will review whom. A sybil ring can wander through many accounts that mirror each other, but its clones rarely land on each other's work, so they cannot rubber-stamp themselves. At the kernel of it, every fake identity must still earn honest approval from strangers, and each one caught posting near-duplicate text forfeits its bond, so the attacker pays real effort and stake per clone.
